name: Kron 3 (Hubble)
blurb: Kron 3, a massive star cluster in the Small Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: kron3-hubble
story: Kron 3 is a massive star cluster in the Small Magellanic Cloud, a satellite of the Milky Way. Hubble observed it among a set of Small Magellanic Cloud clusters to measure their ages and test models of how stars evolve.

claims.text: Kron 3 is a massive star cluster in the Small Magellanic Cloud
The Small Magellanic Cloud is a satellite of the Milky Way
Kron 3 is one of the star clusters targeted by program 10396
The program aimed to measure cluster ages and test stellar evolution models
